control system, and may also affect the

the World-Wide Fuel Charter (WWFC) specifi￾cations where it is available. Many of the automo￾bile manufacturers developed this specification

the gasoline meets the WWFC specifications.

designed to reduce vehicle emissions. INFINITI
supports efforts towards cleaner air and sug￾gests that you use reformulated gasoline when

with or without advertising their presence.

not covered by the INFINITI new vehicle
limited warranty.
